findings: Apply the approved business-fact semantic validation to every transported partial UNAVAILABLE fact. An environment fact, when present, must be exactly PRODUCTION, PRE_PRODUCTION, DEVELOPMENT, or TEST; service_criticality must be exactly CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW. Reject BANANA, SEVERE, case variants, arbitrary values, invalid runtime types, coercion, normalization, fallback, and AssetCriticality substitution semantics.

Centralize or reuse one frontend fact-semantic validation path across RESOLVED/READY and partial UNAVAILABLE parsing so the vocabularies cannot diverge. Partial means an allowed fact may be absent, never that a present fact may be semantically invalid.

Preserve valid partial UNAVAILABLE snapshots when every present fact has an approved value, unique identity, valid provenance, no contradiction with available top-level authority, and exact missing requirements. Never promote UNAVAILABLE to READY or fabricate absent facts.

Add focused negative tests for invalid partial environment/service-criticality values, case variants and invalid transport types; positive tests for environment-only, service-criticality-only and another valid subset with provenance/missing requirements; preserve contradiction, provenance, DistCC, null-impact and TASK-0127/TASK-0128 regressions.

Keep business_impact null. Do not add impact classification, legacy BusinessContext/BusinessImpact, Decision, Recommendation, /api/decisions, Risk Manager/Executive synthetic data, mocks, AI/provider authority, DONE transition, Product Owner acceptance, or TASK-0130.
